hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; ok=1; [ "$(git config core.hooksPath)" = .githooks ] || ok=0; for h in pre-commit commit-msg post-commit pre-merge-commit; do [ -x .githooks/$h ] || ok=0; done; [ $ok = 1 ] || echo '警告：提交闸门没装或失效（core.hooksPath 应为 .githooks、.githooks/ 下四个钩子须可执行），此时提交不会被拦。修复：git config core.hooksPath .githooks。见仓库工作须知 §7。'; n=$(git notes --ref=gate-skip list 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$n" -eq 0 ] || echo "有 $n 个提交未经闸门，查看：git log --notes=gate-skip；按须知 §7 补理由。"
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { git log -1 --format='HEAD %h %s'; git status -sb | head -20; }; echo '压缩或恢复后先重读当前工作项。'
